summary: Separate host execution commands and reactive physical observations from full-node graph decisions

replay.detail: Existing runtime-start admission and result custody remain authoritative; no serialized command or receipt bytes change.

schema.detail: No claim, wire or durable journal schema changes. This is an internal full-node boundary, not a remote agent mode.

rules.detail: The graph still chooses launches and controls. Immutable command handlers retain cancellation, operation, incarnation and process-birth guards and persist existing start results before graph adoption.

compatibility.detail: Native registry revisions and existing safety/deadline wakes scope physical observation work. Member and mission evaluation share the physical process observation boundary, so unrelated fleet writes do not resample unchanged native execution evidence. Destructive operations retain fresh native checks.

downtime.detail: No topology cutover or migration is required.

manual.detail: No new configuration. Performance evaluation labels distinguish physical observation/process work from graph-side mail observations.

recovery.detail: Restart uses the existing durable operation journal. Native watch failures retain no current-evidence claim; existing safety wakes preserve abrupt process-loss detection. Graph-side mail observation retains full-shard mission dependencies and durable receipt deduplication.
